CourseName: CEN3722 - Introduction to Human Computer Interfaces

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: This artifact outlines the module's topic structure, covering Figma fundamentals such as the interface, frames, grids, component libraries, and auto-layout, serving as a syllabus-style roadmap for learners and instructors to navigate the module's content sequence.

Artifacts.Name: ai_assisted_design_figma_prototype
Artifacts.Description: This group project artifact guides student teams through Phase 4 of a semester-long design sequence, tasking them with building an AI-assisted interface prototype in Figma that builds on their prior task analysis work, with an estimated team effort of 2–4 hours.
